tasks.spec: Work in /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge directly (no worktree). Never git commit, never run `uv`, never call a billed model or the network. Run tests as `PYTHONPATH=$PWD TMPDIR=/tmp .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider <tests>`. ROLE: story-package fixer. You may edit ONLY: data/stories/continuity-initiative/{pacing.yaml,storylet-routes.yaml,knowledge.yaml,handoffs.yaml,world.yaml,incidents.yaml,storylets.md}, tests/test_3c_finale_journey.py, tests/test_3c_cue_chain.py, tests/test_story_ending.py, scripts/ringer/phase2/act3c_probe.py, scripts/ringer/phase2/check_act3c_probe.py and tests/test_act3c_probe.py. Do NOT edit storygame/ or plot.md. DEFECT FOUND LIVE (Round 10 row 57): the 3C neutral recovery never fires for a player who has not finished the broadcast and archive episodes, and as written it needs the player to TYPE a command. Read these exemplars first and copy their SHAPE exactly: recovery storylet SL-2C-E in storylet-routes.yaml (activation conditions are ONLY `purge_window_missed`), the knowledge entries k_purge_recovery_ready (audience world_only, establishes purge_recovery_ready) and k_sl_2c_e_route_effects (carries the route effects, must_convey) in knowledge.yaml, and the pacing events purge_window_2c and purge_nudge_2c in pacing.yaml (find which event or effect asserts `purge_recovery_ready`; copy that wiring), plus how incidents.yaml wires recovery_storylet_id for i_2c_rebecca_corridor. Also compare 2A (SL-2A-D) and 2B (SL-2B-D). FIX: (1) SL-3C-H activation conditions become ONLY `evacuation_window_missed: true` (remove `truth_no_longer_containable` and `rebecca_captured`). The outcome storylet SL-3C-C keeps requiring both episodes. (2) Replace the action-earned knowledge entry k_sl_3c_h_r1 (it has action_evidence 'let/allow ... surge/water/gates', which makes a recovery depend on a typed command) with the Act 2 pair: a world_only `k_evacuation_recovery_ready` that establishes a NEW fact `evacuation_recovery_ready`, and a `k_sl_3c_h_route_effects` entry that asserts `evacuation_complete` and `surge_forced_evacuation` and NOTHING else (no outcome, no cost), with a short must_convey phrase that is NOT an outcome phrase. Declare `evacuation_recovery_ready` everywhere facts are declared, set it from the same kind of event effect the 2C chain uses (the nudge or the window event, whichever 2C uses), and update incidents.yaml `observation_knowledge_ids` for i_3c_evacuation accordingly. Keep the delivered text short and in the existing voice. (3) The ending must still fire on the turn the recovery completes, and the base ending plus the `surge_forced_evacuation` variant must show. TESTS AND PROBE: in tests/test_3c_finale_journey.py the missed-window path (c) must start from a fresh 3C arrival with NO broadcast or archive facts set and reach the ending by the neutral recovery with no player command that mentions the surge; assert no outcome fact is set. In scripts/ringer/phase2/act3c_probe.py make the `stall` prefix honest: its dry path must be the eight NEUTRAL_COMMANDS only, with no BROADCAST_COMMAND, ARCHIVE_COMMAND or RECOVERY_COMMAND, and the scripted dry provider must NOT select any knowledge for it (the real engine recovery must end the story); delete RECOVERY_COMMAND if nothing else uses it. Update check_act3c_probe.py and tests/test_act3c_probe.py to match. Run the package loader on the real package, then the 3C and package suites listed in the check, and fix failures. Leave changes uncommitted.
